clusters.name: measurement-gate
clusters.executionModeRationale: Pre-ship offline measurement script lives outside the crews plugin. Gates whether subsequent clusters are worth running; no file overlap with code clusters and so can run first standalone.

clusters.name: foundation-libs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Two independent helper modules with disjoint files and disjoint tests. Can run in parallel with measurement-gate because neither touches review-mail.js or the same test file.

clusters.name: core-collapse
clusters.executionModeRationale: All six stories edit review-mail.js or the new collapse helper or its tests. Same-file edits across review-mail.js, command-args-parity.test.js, and the new collapse helper force serial execution; each story builds on the previous one logically (helper -> wire-in -> cursor regression -> env-off bit-identical -> stderr warning -> telemetry).

clusters.name: ship-and-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Version bump touches 6 files in lockstep (plugin.json x2 + 3 marketplace indexes + version.test.js). CHANGELOG and AGENTS.md must reference shipped behavior, so this cluster runs after core-collapse. Risk = medium because marketplace.json drift is a known repeat failure mode (per repo AGENTS.md warning) and the codexu-root AGENTS.md row must match the bumped plugin version.
